title: Analyst&Tester
description: About ICterra ICterra is a global software engineering company with offices in Munich, İstanbul and Ankara. We combine 30 years of software development experience with technology expertise and proven methodologies to provide innovative solutions to our customers across multiple industries globally. With 150+ software professionals, we have been building strategic partnerships with the world’s top IT and defence companies, providing software development and test services. We are looking for an experienced Analyst & Tester who will take an active role in the analysis and testing of Payment Orchestration and Payment Gateway solutions. Responsibilities Analyze and document business and system requirements related to payment processes and integrations. Prepare functional analysis documents, process flows, user stories, acceptance criteria, and test scenarios. Analyze and test integrations with banks, acquirers, PSPs, and payment platforms . Validate end-to-end payment flows including authorization, 3D Secure, capture, refund, cancellation/void, reversal, retry, reconciliation, and settlement . Test payment routing, fallback, timeout, callback/webhook, error-handling, and transaction status scenarios. Perform REST/SOAP API testing using Postman, SoapUI, Swagger , or similar tools. Validate transaction data and business rules using Oracle Database and PL/SQL . Analyze transaction and application logs using Kibana / Elasticsearch . Perform functional, regression, integration, end-to-end, UAT, and production validation tests. Track defects and support root cause analysis for payment and integration issues. Qualifications Minimum 3 years of experience in business/system analysis, software testing, or QA. Hands-on experience in Payment Gateway and/or Payment Orchestration projects. Strong knowledge of payment processes such as authorization, capture, refund, reversal, reconciliation, and settlement . Experience with bank, acquirer, PSP, or payment institution integrations . Experience in high-volume transactional environments is strongly preferred . Strong REST/SOAP API testing experience. Good knowledge of SQL and hands-on experience with Oracle PL/SQL . Knowledge of payment routing, retry, fallback, timeout, idempotency, and transaction consistency concepts. Experience with Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, HP ALM , or similar tools. Experience with Kibana / Elasticsearch is preferred. Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and communication skills.

title: Python & Java Developer
description: Vitelco olarak 2014'ten bu yana Türkiye ve yurtdışındaki müşterilerimize uçtan uca Bilişim Teknolojileri (BT) hizmetleri sunuyoruz. Yazılım Geliştirme, Test, DevOps ve BT Operasyonları alanlarında hizmet vermenin yanı sıra kendi ürünlerimizi geliştiriyor, sektörün lider çözümleri için sistem entegratörü olarak faaliyet gösteriyoruz. "Çok Yönlülük" ve "İnovasyon" ilkeleriyle hareket eden Vitelco, müşterilerine kapsamlı, esnek ve katma değerli çözümler sunmayı hedefliyor. Telekom ekibimize katılacak, güçlü yazılım geliştirme deneyimine sahip ve yapay zeka teknolojileri konusunda tecrübeli bir Python & Java Developer arıyoruz. Gerekli Yeterlilikler ve Beceriler Üniversitelerin Bilgisayar Mühendisliği veya ilgili bölümlerinden mezun Python ile en az 5 yıl profesyonel geliştirme deneyimi (Django, FastAPI veya Flask gibi framework'lerden en az birine hâkim) Java ile geliştirme deneyimi (tercihen Spring / Spring Boot) Oracle veritabanı ile çalışmış; SQL ve tercihen PL/SQL bilgisine sahip REST API, Git ve temel yazılım mimarisi prensiplerine hâkim Python ile ölçeklenebilir, sürdürülebilir backend servisleri ve uygulamalar geliştirmek Mevcut Java tabanlı sistemlerin geliştirilmesine, bakımına ve entegrasyonlarına destek olmak Oracle veritabanı üzerinde sorgu, tablo yapısı ve performans iyileştirmeleri yapmak REST API'ler tasarlamak ve sistemler arası entegrasyonları kurmak AI/ML tabanlı çözümlerin uygulamalara entegrasyonunda yer almak Kod incelemelerine katılmak, test yazmak ve dokümantasyon hazırlamak Analitik düşünebilen, takım çalışmasına yatkın Analitik düşünme ve problem çözme yetkinliği. Sunduklarımız Sürekli kariyer gelişimi Uluslararası bir ekibin parçası olma fırsatı Ömür boyu öğrenen biri olarak Vitelco Academy'de eğitim programlarına katılma ve iş birliği yapılan üniversitelerde akademik çalışmalar için özel indirimlerden yararlanma fırsatı Hem restoranlarda hem de marketlerde kullanabileceğiniz bir yemek kartı Özel hastanelerde ve sağlık kuruluşlarında kullanabileceğiniz özel sağlık sigortası

title: Mobile Application Developer and Support Analyst
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Mobile Application Developer and Support Analyst based in Turkey. As a Mobile Application Developer and Support Analyst, you will design, develop, test, deploy, support, and optimize SAP-based mobile applications and extensions. You will work extensively with SAP Mobile Development Kit (MDK), SAP Business Application Studio (BAS), and SAP BTP Mobile Services. The role combines hands-on mobile development with technical troubleshooting and ongoing application support. You will collaborate with SAP developers, functional consultants, business stakeholders, and other technology teams to deliver reliable and scalable mobile solutions. Your work will span integrations, offline-first functionality, backend extensions, security, and device capabilities. This is a remote opportunity suited to a technically strong professional who can take ownership of mobile solutions throughout their lifecycle. Accountabilities Design, develop, test, deploy, support, and optimize SAP-based mobile applications and extensions using SAP MDK, BAS, and SAP BTP Mobile Services. Create and maintain SAP MDK pages, rules, actions, and application functionality aligned with business requirements. Integrate mobile applications with OData services and SAP S/4HANA environments. Implement and maintain offline synchronization and offline-first mobile capabilities. Develop and maintain backend extensions using technologies such as SAP CAP, Node.js, or Java. Configure SAP BTP destinations, roles, authentication mechanisms, and security policies. Implement integrations with mobile device capabilities, including camera, GPS, barcode and QR scanning, and file handling. Support mobile application deployment across iOS and Android platforms. Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize applications to ensure reliability, performance, and a high-quality user experience. Work closely with SAP development teams, functional consultants, business stakeholders, and other technology teams throughout the application lifecycle. Contribute to technical documentation and communicate technical issues, solutions, and recommendations clearly. Requirements 3+ years of hands-on experience developing with SAP Mobile Development Kit (MDK). 3+ years of hands-on experience with SAP Business Application Studio (BAS). 3+ years of hands-on experience with SAP BTP Mobile Services. SAP certification in one or more of SAP BTP, SAP MDK, or SAP Mobile Services. Strong experience developing SAP MDK pages, rules, and actions. Proven experience integrating MDK applications with OData services and SAP S/4HANA. Experience implementing offline synchronization and offline-first mobile functionality. Strong JavaScript development skills. Experience with SAP Fiori design and application development. Experience deploying mobile applications for both iOS and Android. Experience developing backend extensions using SAP CAP, Node.js, or Java. Experience working with SAP HANA Cloud and HDI containers. Practical knowledge of BTP destinations, roles, authentication, and security policies. Experience with OAuth and SAML. Experience integrating applications with device capabilities such as cameras, GPS, barcode and QR scanners, and file handling. Strong troubleshooting, debugging, performance optimization, and application support skills. Excellent technical documentation and communication abilities. Ability to collaborate effectively with developers, functional consultants, business stakeholders, and cross-functional technology teams. Post-secondary education related to Computer Technology or a comparable technical discipline. Benefits Fully remote work environment. Contract opportunity. Hands-on ownership of SAP mobile application development and support. Opportunity to work across SAP MDK, SAP BTP Mobile Services, BAS, SAP S/4HANA, and related technologies. Exposure to mobile development across both iOS and Android platforms. Opportunity to collaborate with technical, functional, and business teams on enterprise technology solutions. How Jobgether Works We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. We appreciate your interest and wish you the best! Why Apply Through Jobgether? Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Software Engineer
description: We are looking for an experienced Senior Software Engineer who will be responsible for designing, developing and maintaining high scalable, reliable and efficient software applications. The successful candidate will work closely with cross-functional teams to deliver complex software solutions. Qualifications Minimum of 3 years of software development experience. Experience designing and developing highly scalable, multi-user application architectures. Strong background in object-oriented software development. Solid understanding of SOLID principles and design patterns. Knowledge of DevOps practices. Experience with relational and NoSQL databases. Experience with Microservices Architecture and messaging technologies such as RabbitMQ. Experience with distributed caching technologies such as Redis. Knowledge of cloud technologies and cloud-native development. Hands-on experience with C#, ASP.NET, .NET Framework, and .NET Core. Knowledge of front-end technologies including HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and React. Experience with Domain-Driven Design (DDD) and Test-Driven Development (TDD). Strong attention to detail with a focus on documentation. Collaborative team player with excellent communication skills. Accountable and proactive, with the ability to take technical ownership and initiative when needed. Experience with Kibana and Elasticsearch. Experience with Oracle PL/SQL. Good written and spoken English Experience in CRM systems and customer relationship management applications. Responsibilities Research and develop new technologies and evaluate their usability. Provide end-to-end software development expertise and mentor software engineers. Coordinate and actively participate in the analysis, design, and development of Digiturk infrastructure applications. Contribute to the continuous improvement and enhancement of the software infrastructure. Guide and support software teams building applications on the infrastructure and provide technical expertise on selected technologies. Design or oversee data architecture and application architecture for software solutions. Stay up to date with emerging technologies and adapt innovations to organizational needs. Establish and enforce coding standards, ensuring compliance across development teams. Adapt to a fast-paced work environment with strong time management skills.

title: Technology Internship Program
description: About Paribu Founded in 2017, Paribu has been playing a key role in the development of Türkiye’s crypto asset ecosystem by delivering innovative blockchain-based products and services. It offers a fast, easy, and secure exchange experience with more than 210 crypto assets. In 2024, Paribu introduced Paribu Custody, one of the few globally digital asset custody solutions tailored for institutional clients. At the same time, Paribu offers a secure self-custody experience for individuals and startups through its next-generation crypto wallet solution, Paribu Self. Beyond its mission to increase blockchain adoption, Paribu is committed to shaping the future by actively supporting culture, arts, sports, and education . Why join Paribu? Paribu works with curious, innovative, and impact-driven professionals who are passionate about pushing boundaries and driving technological advancement. It fosters a culture of continuous learning, collaboration, and sharing. Whether you specialise in technology, design, strategy, operations, or beyond , you will be part of a team shaping the future of finance. Paribu provides a working environment where ideas turn into reality, and innovation thrives. Here, you'll work alongside talented professionals, tackle exciting challenges, and contribute to meaningful projects that align with Paribu’s vision of delivering fast, easy, and secure experiences. The impact you'll make At Paribu, every team member plays a crucial role in driving innovation and delivering high-quality solutions. Through our Technology Internship Program, our Tech team is hiring both Software Engineering and Product interns this cycle. Whichever track you join, you will be responsible for: Supporting engineering and product teams in the development, testing, and improvement of software products Contributing to ongoing projects while gaining hands-on experience in real-world development environments Collaborating with engineers, product managers, and cross-functional teams to understand problems and contribute to practical solutions Participating in coding, testing, and debugging (Software Engineering track), or in product discovery, requirement writing, and documentation (Product track) Learning and applying modern software development and product practices, tools, and technologies Exploring AI-assisted development and product tools to support your learning experience Key competencies We value potential, curiosity, and willingness to learn as much as experience. We're looking for: 4th-year undergraduate students in Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Science, Industrial Engineering, or a related field, graduating in 2027 Availability to work 3–4 days per week throughout the program Software Engineering track: Solid CS fundamentals (data structures, algorithms, OOP), basic knowledge of at least one programming language (Java, Go, Python, JavaScript/Node.js, C#), and familiarity with Git, SQL/NoSQL, and frontend technologies Product track: Strong analytical thinking, a basic understanding of how software products are built, and comfort working with data to support decision-making Strong problem-solving skills, curiosity about new technologies, and a collaborative mindset Please indicate in your application which track (Software Engineering or Product) you are applying for. The advantages of being at Paribu Paribu invests in its team’s growth, well-being, and happiness. Here’s what you can expect: Meal allowance – Generous support with a flexible meal card. Private health insurance – Comprehensive coverage for employees, including spouse and children . Commuting support – Financial support for commuting based on your office route. S.O.S. leave (10 days) – Additional leave days up to 10 days per year for urgent and unexpected matters, apart from annual leave. Birthday leave – One extra day off during your birthday month. Language learning support – Resources to enhance English communication skills. Personal development support – Budget for exploring hobbies, attending professional courses, and personal growth. Well-being & health platform – Access to digital health and wellness services, including mental health support, and well-being resources. Top-tier work equipment – High-performance devices and all the essential tools you need to do your best work. Cultural events – Enjoy concerts, theater, cinema, and sports tickets through company-sponsored raffles. The hiring journey From application to onboarding, here's a step-by-step look at your journey with Paribu. 1. Application: Submit your application online. 2. Initial screening: People Team reviews your resume. 3. Assessment tests: Complete a case study or technical test to help us better understand your problem-solving and technical skills. 4. Panel Interview: Meet with team members. 5. Office Interview: Meet with hiring managers. 6. Offer & onboarding: If it’s a great fit, you will be welcomed on board. Application process Should you have already applied, here are two essential facts about the process: While we carefully review every application, only candidates whose profiles best align with the role will be contacted. We appreciate your understanding on this matter. All applications received by Paribu are treated equally, without prejudice to age, gender, religion, race, disability, or marital status, in full compliance with personal data protection principles. In accordance with applicable data protection regulations, please note the following: You have been informed that my personal data is processed by Paribu Teknoloji A.Ş. (“Paribu” or “Company”) through the “ Paribu Teknoloji A.Ş. Clarification Text on the Protection of Personal Data for Employee Candidates ” prepared as part of the job application process of employee candidates and in accordance with the Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698.

Görev ve Sorumluluklar BİLGİ İŞLEM YÖNETİMİ IT DESTEK PYTHON KODLAMA PROJE YÖNETİMİ MARKA TASARIMI ENDÜSTRİYEL TASARIM alanlarındaki yurt içi veya uluslararası projelere destek olmak, Proje planlama, görev takibi ve süreç raporlarının hazırlanması, Kurum prosedürlerine, gizlilik kurallarına, bilgi güvenliği ilkelerine ve profesyonel çalışma disiplinine uygun hareket etmek. title: Application Development Engineer (Supply Chain)
description: Are You Ready to Join LC Waikiki’s Digital Transformation Journey? 🚀 With over 1,300 stores across 60 countries, LC Waikiki continues to grow with the philosophy "Everyone Deserves to Dress Well." Beyond fashion and retail, we are also taking important steps in technology and digital transformation. At LC Waikiki Digital Transformation & Information Technologies , we are shaping the future with a team of more than 850 professionals, focusing on innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement. By following Agile/Scrum methodologies , we work together to build smarter and more efficient solutions every day. What Will You Do? Our projects go beyond retail, creating an impact across the digital world. If you want to be part of this exciting journey, here is what you can expect: Develop software solutions, contribute to technical design, and take an active role in projects beyond just writing code. Work closely with an Agile team and contribute to every stage of the software development lifecycle. Design and develop applications for web platforms . Take part in local and global projects involving third-party system integrations . Contribute to LC Waikiki’s digital transformation through the software solutions you develop. Who Are We Looking For? We are looking for a passionate and motivated Application Development Engineer who enjoys technology, follows new trends, and is always eager to learn and improve. You might be a great fit if you: Have a degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field . Have strong knowledge of .NET Core and C# . Have experience with web technologies such as Angular, React, and ASP.NET. Are familiar with Agile/Scrum methodologies and enjoy working in an Agile environment. Are curious about new technologies and open to continuous learning. Have knowledge of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) and software design principles. Have experience with T-SQL and Web APIs . Actively use AI-powered development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or similar tools for coding, debugging, and testing. Preferably have knowledge or experience in Microservices architecture, Docker, MongoDB, Redis, and Kafka . Then you might be the one we are looking for! What Do We Offer? A collaborative and inclusive work environment. Opportunities to work with the latest technologies and development tools. Continuous learning and professional development opportunities. Employee discounts on LC Waikiki products and much more! Join Us! We are excited to meet software developers who want to make an impact in the digital world and grow with us. If this opportunity sounds exciting to you, apply now and become part of LC Waikiki’s digital transformation journey! At LC Waikiki, we are committed to considering our environmental and social impacts throughout our value chain while developing and maintaining an ethical, responsible, and sustainable business model that respects human rights. The person in this role is expected to consider not only the balance between cost, quality, and speed in decisions and practices within their area of responsibility and influence, but also resource efficiency, the use of sustainable materials, responsible production and procurement practices, respect for human rights, decent working conditions, and ethical business principles. In addition, they are expected to contribute to the identification, management, and monitoring of relevant sustainability impacts, risks, and opportunities. Recruitment Process Interview / Technical Assessment Assessment Center Reference Check Job Offer The recruitment process may vary depending on the position. We carefully review every application. If your qualifications match the position requirements, we will contact you by phone or email.
